author: serafimcloud
name: ghostly-embrace
description: Animated WebGL shader background in the Metaballs style, generated by the 21st.dev Shader Builder. 4-color palette (#101010, #F5F5F5, #B0B0B0, #3A3A3A). Features: high intensity. A drop-in, zero-dependency React component for hero sections and animated gradient/noise backgrounds.
